summary: Iteration 18 full regression + new scope: Waitlist zero-friction modal, Contact rebuild, preselect auto-expand, bento/AI-core polish, 3D loading. Backend pytest suite 19/19 passed (test_fluxvex_api.py). Frontend Playwright flows all PASSED on the external preview URL: (1) Waitlist modal from nav shows exactly email+submit+trust+collapsed disclosure; invalid 'agency@' blocked client-side with inline error 'That email doesn’t look right — try you@agency.com.' and NO POST /api/waitlist fired; valid email submitted → success view with burst animation, email echoed, Done button closes modal. (2) /pricing growth CTA opens modal with disclosure auto-expanded and waitlist-interest-select=Growth. (3) Contact empty submit fires NO POST /api/contact (client-side validation blocked); progressive fixes (bad email → fix → short message → fix) end at success with 'Priya' first-name + email echoed; 'Send another message' resets to a fresh form; second submission succeeds. (4) Both test emails verified persisted in Mongo (test_database.waitlist + test_database.contact_messages). (5) AI-core band renders 5 vision-ai-capability cards (3 marked vision-ai-capability-future). No pageerrors on / or /contact.
critical_code_review_comments: Headless WebGL noise: 'Too many active WebGL contexts' warnings are frequent in Playwright runs — not a user-facing bug but worth noting for future test stability (consider gating Three.js scenes behind IntersectionObserver more aggressively, or reusing a single WebGLRenderer across isometric scenes).

On home with heavy scroll, canvas count sometimes reads 0 in headless because scenes are below the viewport+lazy; a canvas probe should scroll into the specific scene section (not blind-wheel), but this is a test-harness concern not a product bug.
